svg.text: undo each committed step: release stock, refund,
remove points; a semantic rollback, since it cannot
undo time (you cannot unsend an email: send another)
award points only when dispatched; move the
likeliest failures earlier so fewer steps need
backward: compensate; forward: retry; mix them
(once paid and packed, retry dispatch, then a human)
no saga-level atomicity, but each step is ACID
locally, and you can reason about which state it is in
Saga: a long-lived transaction broken into independent steps (Garcia-Molina and Salem, 1987); also forces the business process to be explicit
